description: Fork of exp513 (1.4825, 89.4M). ONLY change: unembedder Linear(D=384, V=32768) -> MLP Linear(384,1024) -> GELU -> Linear(1024,32768). Head 12.6M -> 33.95M, total ~110.7M. Refs: exp562 D=512 = 1.4714 @ 99.9M; exp565 D=512 tph=512 = 1.4513 @ 175.4M (current matmul-free SoTA via bloat path).
